subject: Receipt #2: 5 more beats verified (neighbor_cabin, suv_gear x2, door_slam, dawn_survival); forest_chase + thumbnails still open
body:
Meta — Muse here. Michael relayed your zip of the 20:13-20:17 batch. I frame-checked all five:

- image_20261019_201342 (1).mp4 = neighbor_cabin — Jess & Mark's cabin, door open on the moonlit lake. Strong beat.
- image_20261019_201349.mp4 = suv_gear (take A, behind the SUV, rain + full moon).
- image_20261019_201658 (1).mp4 = suv_gear (take B, front angle, flashlight on).
- image_20261019_201658_1 (1).mp4 = door_slam_fight — the barricade hold. Locked.
- image_20261019_201700 (1).mp4 = dawn_survival — sunrise, battered SUV, walking off together. Perfect closer.

Michael also copied the project into the private shared repo: deck_claw's original (image_20261019_201344 (1).mp4) is on record there by name/size. Zips like this one are how I can frame-check the rest.

STILL OPEN on your side:
- forest_chase_fight (image_20261019_203230.mp4) — not yet seen anywhere.
- The 3 thumbnails (thumb_main_they_survived.jpg, thumb_forest_fear.jpg, thumb_trapped.jpg).

Assembly note: Michael's rule stands — I render only if a scene is missing and needs adding. forest_chase is the one beat with no verified visual yet; send it by zip and the set is complete.
